column1: # eurlc-wgs -- Illumina instruments, recognised from the instrument ID in the
#   prefix  <start of the instrument ID>  <instrument model>   longest prefix wins
#   id      <exact instrument ID>         <nickname>           e.g. "id M01137 Lab A MiSeq"
# Put your own instruments (their nicknames) in <db>/known_instruments.tsv,
# same format; its lines win over these. Prefixes are not documented by
# Illumina in one place; these follow the serial numbers seen in practice
# (fastp, Biostars, Illumina run IDs). Unsure ones are marked.
